---
title: Templates
description: Complete starter apps built from the kit, installed as your own source with one command.
pro: true
---

A template is a whole app, not a block: routes, navigation, realistic data and every state a real
product has (empty, loading, error), composed only from rectio components, blocks and tokens. It
switches between both themes, light and dark, like everything in the kit.

```sh
rectio init --template <name> my-app
```

The CLI writes the app into a new folder, installs the kit items it uses as source you own, and
records them in `rectio.lock.json` so `rectio diff` keeps working. Each template is a Next.js app
with a static export, so it runs from any static host until you wire your own backend.
